summary: The mutation_gate job now installs mutmut 3.8.0 (the version measured on the runner), runs scripts.mutation_engine, which mutates the required files and writes build/mutation.json, and then scripts.mutation_ci, which gates on those results. The results file is kept as an artifact for a week. With no required file the engine prints NO MANDATORY FILES and runs nothing, so every merge request that does not touch a critical path behaves as before. This edits .gitlab-ci.yml, a human-only file, so the human opens and merges it, after task_046 (the scripts) and before task_048 (the critical path and the minimum in state/config.json): with the path set and no job, every change to src/afaw_web would fail for lack of results. Checked: tests/tooling/test_gitlab_ci.py passes. Not run: this job on a real merge request; the job is not claimed to work until it has.
